instruction: Repair {{entry}}, a POSIX sh script accepting exactly one directory argument. For each regular non-symlink .txt file directly in that directory, emit basename, a tab and its logical line count, in LC_ALL=C basename order. An empty file has zero lines; a nonempty final line without newline counts as one. Handle directory/file names containing spaces and leading dashes. Ignore other files/subdirectories. Invalid arguments exit 2 without stdout. Paths and filenames do not contain tabs or newlines.
